description: The files of ONE document in any corpus, as downloadable links, plus its title and series. Take corpus and doc_key straight from a search_documents hit. 'wamex' returns the report's original PDF, appendix zips and an OCR'd copy; 'ebookshop' the publication's PDF; 'geolit' the paper's single PDF, with its title, journal and year; 'hylogger' the one report PDF, with the hole, state and NVCL dataset id; 'sarig' the one report PDF, with its abstract, tenements, holder and year. Use it to give the reader something they can open — a claim someone can check is worth more than one they have to take on trust. A geolit paper whose copy is licensed for text mining only returns no file: the passage stays quotable, so cite it with journal and year rather than dropping it.

corpus.description: Which corpus the key belongs to.

doc_key.description: The hit's doc_key: a WAMEX anumber ('A12345'), a GSWA product code ('N19EB'), a geolit sha256, or a hylogger '<dataset id>.sp' key, or a sarig key ('env02577').
